principle: Agentic systems earn trust continuously through verified identity, just-in-time credentials, least privilege, registry trust, policy enforcement, sandboxing, immutable traces, human control, adversarial evaluation, and incident response.

zero_trust_controls.name: Agent and Non-Human Identity Registry
zero_trust_controls.purpose: Assign every agent, sub-agent, routine, service account, and tool runner a unique identity with actor-chain attribution.
p0_blockers: agentic action cannot be attributed to user, tenant, agent, and credential
sub-agents can act without registered identity
tenant boundary is unclear

zero_trust_controls.name: JIT Credential Broker and Vault
zero_trust_controls.purpose: Issue short-lived scoped credentials from a vault or broker only at the moment a verified action needs them.
p0_blockers: long-lived broad credentials are available to agents
secrets are stored in prompts, skill files, repo config, or client code
credential revocation path is missing

zero_trust_controls.name: Per-Action Authorization and Intent Verification
zero_trust_controls.purpose: Authorize every sensitive action against user intent, task scope, agent role, policy, risk, credential scope, and approval threshold.
p0_blockers: public, paid, destructive, or compliance-sensitive actions can run without per-action authorization
approval thresholds are undefined
agent can act outside current user intent

zero_trust_controls.name: Tool, MCP, Skill, Agent Card, and Model Registry
zero_trust_controls.purpose: Vett and version the supply chain of tools, MCP servers, connectors, skills, harnesses, agent cards, models, prompts, and policy bundles.
p0_blockers: unreviewed tools, MCP servers, skills, models, or agent cards can be used in launch-critical flows
tool capabilities are broader than the agent task
no owner or version exists for privileged tool surfaces

zero_trust_controls.name: AI Gateway, Firewall, and Policy Enforcement
zero_trust_controls.purpose: Enforce deterministic checks around model inputs, retrieved context, tool inputs, model outputs, egress, and delegated payloads.
p0_blockers: model output directly drives privileged tool calls without validation
untrusted retrieved content is not labeled or constrained
sensitive output can leave through uncontrolled egress

zero_trust_controls.name: Data, Memory, Retrieval, and Model Integrity
zero_trust_controls.purpose: Protect the sources that shape decisions: memories, RAG indexes, embeddings, policies, preferences, eval sets, fine-tuning data, and model artifacts.
p0_blockers: retrieved context or memory can be trusted without provenance
policies or preferences can be tampered with silently
poisoned sources cannot be quarantined or rolled back

zero_trust_controls.name: Micro-Sandboxing and Segmentation
zero_trust_controls.purpose: Constrain agents by file path, network destination, database scope, tenant data, tool operation, subprocess, browser state, and production mutation boundary.
p0_blockers: agents can access broad filesystem, network, or tenant scopes without need
tool runners can mutate production without boundary
browser or Computer Use state is not isolated for sensitive workflows

zero_trust_controls.name: Immutable Observability and Forensic Trace
zero_trust_controls.purpose: Record tamper-evident evidence for prompts, context, retrieval, memory, model route, policy, credential checkout, tool calls, approvals, and external actions.
p0_blockers: bad agent outcome cannot be reconstructed
credential checkout or approval events are not logged
privileged logs are mutable without tamper controls

zero_trust_controls.name: Human Control, Kill Switch, Throttles, and Canaries
zero_trust_controls.purpose: Give humans practical controls to approve, pause, stop, revoke, throttle, canary, roll back, and investigate agentic behavior.
p0_blockers: no kill switch exists for autonomous routines
paid or public actions have no throttle
unsafe rollout cannot be paused or rolled back

zero_trust_controls.name: Continuous Verification and Scanning
zero_trust_controls.purpose: Continuously verify secrets, dependencies, MCP servers, skills, tool schemas, memory sources, retrieval indexes, policy drift, access scopes, logs, and deployed surfaces.
p0_blockers: privileged agentic system has no periodic access review
tool or policy changes bypass review
secret scanning is missing for repos with credentials

zero_trust_controls.name: Adversarial Evaluation and Attack Simulation
zero_trust_controls.purpose: Test launch-critical agentic flows against prompt injection, tool poisoning, credential misuse, exfiltration, memory poisoning, excessive agency, and A2A spoofing.
p0_blockers: prompt injection and excessive-agency tests are missing for launch-critical flows
adversarial failures do not block release
no regression test guards fixed attacks

zero_trust_controls.name: Incident Response and Blast-Radius Reduction
zero_trust_controls.purpose: Define containment, credential rotation, agent freeze, poisoned-source removal, memory rollback, trace replay, notification, and postmortem paths.
p0_blockers: privileged agentic product has no containment plan
compromised credentials cannot be rotated quickly
memory or retrieval poisoning cannot be repaired

risk_patterns.name: Social Content Autopublisher
risk_patterns.first_secure_slice: draft-only social workflow: retrieve approved voice/proof memory, produce draft, run policy/evidence checks, record trace, require human approval before any platform write

risk_patterns.name: Financial or Market Intelligence Agent
risk_patterns.first_secure_slice: read-only market thesis workflow: pull verified sources, separate advice from analysis, trace citations, block trading or external messages until explicit human approval and compliance policy exist

risk_patterns.name: Enterprise Operations Agent
risk_patterns.first_secure_slice: single low-risk ticket workflow: read scoped case data, propose action, record policy decision, require approval for external send/delete/refund, then replay trace in review

risk_patterns.name: Creative Media Generation Agent
risk_patterns.first_secure_slice: quota-limited media job: generate from approved prompt and licensed assets, store output in sandbox, record cost/content-policy trace, require human approval before publication

risk_patterns.name: Multi-Agent or Inter-OS Network
risk_patterns.first_secure_slice: one traced delegation: verify agent card, exchange least-context task payload, require scoped token, record correlation ID, reject unauthorized downstream tool use, and require approval before external action

risk_patterns.name: Memory or RAG-Backed Agent
risk_patterns.first_secure_slice: read-only grounded answer: ingest trusted fixture corpus, label untrusted context, cite sources, block memory writes until provenance, correction, delete/export, and poisoning tests exist
